player_intent: Equipping the M4A1 in SOCOM-141 renders the photoreal potato HD M4A1 model with authentic CoD4-style PBR textures, quad-rail handguard, collapsible waffle stock, and peep-sight optics while maintaining 100% parity with canonical weapon sockets, ballistics, and motion boundaries.
acceptance_rule: The M4A1 potato photoreal asset loads cleanly with under 7,000 triangles, 11 canonical bones matching the AGLS v9 coordinate contract, support-hand foregrip IK contact within 3 cm, 1.2-second fire recovery, and zero drift across CharacterBody3D, SOCOMCamera, and server weapon damage authority.

nodes.role: Instantiates the equipped M4A1 weapon model under the canonical operator and publishes its physical socket nodes to presentation consumers.
Consumes authorized weapon visual rigs, builds runtime sockets, and binds the presentation owners without modifying server authority.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement, posture, and collision authority
SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority or accepted reticle geometry
server shot validation, muzzle, ballistics, damage, and networking authority
right trigger-hand attachment as sole weapon-root transform owner
unrelated weapon profiles and user-authored dirty worktree changes

system_delta.reason: Merge the optimized ~3,800-poly photoreal PBR M4A1 asset and visual rig into the project, providing a drop-in high-fidelity replacement for the untextured placeholder while maintaining 100% socket and bone coordinate parity with the canonical AGLS v9 contract.

current.system: AGLS intake M4A1 placeholder model with vertex colors only and no PBR textures

candidate.system: Potato photoreal M4A1 with baked PBR textures, ray-traced AO, authentic waffle stock, and 100% socket parity

visual_check: Launch res://main.tscn and verify the equipped M4A1 renders with authentic military matte anodized gunmetal, quad rail handguard, collapsible waffle stock, and clear sightline through the rear peep sight.
